name: PM Vishwakarma
ministry: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Central Sector Scheme providing recognition, skill training, toolkit incentive, collateral-free credit, digital transaction incentives and marketing support to artisans and craftspeople.
benefits: Recognition as Vishwakarma through Certificate and ID Card; Skill Verification followed by 5-7 days (40 hours) of Basic Training; 15 days (120 hours) of Advanced Training; Training Stipend: ₹ 500 per day; Toolkit Incentive: ₹ 15,000 grant; Collateral-free Enterprise Development Loans: ₹ 1,00,000 (First Tranche for 18 months repayment) & ₹ 2,00,000 (Second Tranche for 30 months repayment); Concessional Rate of Interest: 5% with Interest Subvention cap of 8% paid by MoMSME; Credit Guarantee fees borne by GoI; Incentive for Digital Transaction: ₹ 1 per transaction for a maximum of up to 100 transactions (monthly); Marketing Support through National Committee for Marketing.
benefits_evidence: Recognition: Recognition as Vishwakarma through Certificate and ID Card
Skilling: Skill Verification followed by 5-7 days (40 hours) of Basic Training
Interested candidates can also enrol for 15 days (120 hours) of Advanced Training
Collateral-free Enterprise Development Loans: ₹ 1,00,000 (First Tranche for 18 months repayment) & ₹ 2,00,000 (Second Tranche for 30 months repayment)
Concessional Rate of Interest: 5% to be charged from the beneficiary with an Interest Subvention cap of 8% to be paid by MoMSME
Credit Guarantee fees to be borne by GoI
Incentive for Digital Transaction: ₹ 1 per transaction for a maximum of up to 100 transactions (monthly)

Marketing Support: The National Committee for Marketing (NCM) will provide services such as Quality Certification, Branding and Promotion, e-commerce Linkage, Trade Fair Advertising, Publicity and Other Marketing Activities.
level_evidence: PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme launched by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises to provide holistic and end-to-end support to artisans and craftspeople through access to collateral free credit, skill training, modern tools, incentive for digital transactions and market linkage support.

rules.reason: Applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools
rules.evidence: The applicant should be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools.

rules.reason: Applicant must be engaged in the unorganized sector on a self-employment basis
rules.evidence: The applicant should be engaged in an unorganized sector on a self-employment basis.

rules.reason: Applicant must be at least 18 years old on the date of registration
rules.evidence: On the date of registration for the scheme, the minimum age of the applicant should be 18 years.

rules.reason: A person in government service and their family members are not eligible
rules.evidence: A person in government service and their family members shall not be eligible.

how_to_apply: Apply online via Common Service Centres (CSCs) by enrolling through the nearest CSC, completing biometric verification, and submitting the online application form.
how_to_apply_evidence: The eligible beneficiaries are required to get themselves enrolled through nearest CSC in their area.
Step 1: Visit your nearest CSC and complete the Biometric Verification Process.
Step 2: In the Online Application Form, fill in all the mandatory details, and click "Submit". In the next screen, note down the "Application Number" for future reference. Click "Done".
